name: lorekiln
description: Local-first persistent memory for Codex agents: deterministic conversation journaling, human-reviewed experience distillation, and authorized Skill or plugin evolution.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first, auditable memory for Codex agents.
interface.longDescription: Add persistent local conversation memory to Codex without automatic context injection. Lorekiln journals completed turns without model calls, distills selected evidence into a governed long-term experience pool, retrieves memory progressively, and keeps Skill or plugin evolution behind separate authorization, Evals, rollback, and acceptance gates.
defaultPrompt: Distill reusable lessons and biases from this work.
Save all uncommitted dialogue through the current completed turn as a memory anchor.
Show the compact index of approved experience in a named domain, then expand selected records.
Modify the named Skill or plugin from approved experience, with a change report and tests.
